title: Complete Implementation — Research First, Implement Fully
description: Before writing any code, research the correct approach (reference engines, codebase patterns, specs). Then implement the full solution: every function body, every edge case, every error path. No shortcuts. If the implementation is 500 lines, write 500 lines. If it handles 10 cases, handle all 10.
whenToUse: Always. Every implementation task must follow this pattern.
whenNotToUse: Never skip this. There are no exceptions to the quality-over-speed rule.
